summary.text: Rod Willett is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates, representing the 58th District since 2020.
The district covers part of Henrico County.
The House profile lists Rod Willett's occupation as consultant and shows Rod Willett as chair of the Health and Human Services Committee.

paragraphs.text: Rod Willett was born in Portsmouth, Virginia.
The profile lists a B.A. (1985) and a J.D. (1990), both from the College of William & Mary in Virginia.
The profile lists the Richmond Performing Arts Alliance, Rx Partnership, the William and Mary Student Engagement and Leadership Advisory Board, and the Wintergreen Nature Foundation Endowment.
Rod Willett serves on the Health and Human Services Committee (as chair), the Agriculture, Chesapeake and Natural Resources Committee, and Appropriations.
